alias.description:
Alias for the key/certificate pair. Values must match the regular expression [\w\s-.]{1,255}.
This must be provided for all formats except selfsignedcert; self-signed certs may specify the alias in either
this parameter or the JSON body.

cert_validity_in_days.description: Validity duration of certificate, in days. Accepts positive non-zero value. Defaults to 365.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

key_size.description: Key size. Default and maximum value is 2048 bits.

keystore.description: The Apigee keystore name associated in an Apigee environment

org_id.description: The Apigee Organization name associated with the Apigee environment

sig_alg.description: Signature algorithm to generate private key. Valid values are SHA512withRSA, SHA384withRSA, and SHA256withRSA

subject.common_name.description: Common name of the organization. Maximum length is 64 characters.

subject.country_code.description: Two-letter country code. Example, IN for India, US for United States of America.

subject.locality.description: City or town name. Maximum length is 128 characters.

subject.org.description: Organization name. Maximum length is 64 characters.

subject.org_unit.description: Organization team name. Maximum length is 64 characters.

subject.state.description: State or district name. Maximum length is 128 characters.

subject_alternative_dns_names.description: List of alternative host names. Maximum length is 255 characters for each value.
